mentions.name: cabinet.mycnc.app (cabinet design & G-code generator)
mentions.description: A free cabinet design tool with a door and drawer front G-code generator for CNC milling, built as an open alternative to paywalled cabinet design software. The G-code generator has been validated by milling a kitchen's worth of cabinet doors on a hobby-grade CNC.
mentions.problem: Cabinet design software is typically gated behind paywalls.
mentions.source_excerpt: I got tired of the paywall surrounding cabinet design so I created https://cabinet.mycnc.app.   Just finished validating the door / drawer front gcode generator by milling a kitchen's worth of doors on a hobby grade CNC.

evidence.value: I got tired of the paywall surrounding cabinet design so I created https://cabinet.mycnc.app.   Just finished validating the door / drawer front gcode generator by milling a kitchen's worth of doors on a hobby grade CNC.

mentions.name: Cabinet Design Tool (cabinet.mycnc.app)
mentions.description: A web-based cabinet design tool, currently in early alpha, built as an affordable alternative to the high-priced commercial cabinet design software. It supports designing cabinets for DIY construction, with the author using it to design and build cabinets for two kitchens using a Sienci Labs CNC router.
mentions.problem: Cabinet design is gated behind expensive industry software and services, making it costly for individuals who want to design and build their own cabinets.
mentions.source_excerpt: I got tired of the money wall around cabinet design so I am working on https://cabinet.mycnc.app.   Some very alpha features still but getting there.

evidence.value: I got tired of the money wall around cabinet design so I am working on https://cabinet.mycnc.app.   Some very alpha features still but getting there.
